title: Advertisers Push Back on Disney Seeking $10 Million for 30-Second Super Bowl Commercial

facts.fact: Disney's initial ask for a single 30-second commercial slot in Super Bowl LXI is $10 million, according to a Variety report that advertisers are pushing back on.
facts.quote: Disney has started their initial ask for $10 million for a single 30-second commercial slot.

facts.fact: Super Bowl ads sold for around $5 million in 2016, per the article's reference point.
facts.quote: For reference, Super Bowl ads sold for around $5 million in 2016.

facts.fact: NBC's top sales executive for Super Bowl LX, Mark Marshall, said NBC sold a handful of 2026 commercial slots for over $10 million.
facts.quote: 2026 Super Bowl LX top sales executive Mark Marshall revealed that NBC sold a handful of commercial slots for over $10 million.

facts.fact: For Super Bowl LX, NBC's initial starting price for commercial slots was $7 million.
facts.quote: However, the initial starting price was $7 million, which sparked so much demand

facts.fact: The bulk of Super Bowl LX commercial slots sold between $7 million and $8 million.
facts.quote: The bulk of commercial slots were actually sold between $7 million and $8 million.

facts.fact: In recent years, broadcasters NBC and Fox have sold 40% to 60% of their ad schedule before the sale season kicks off in May.
facts.quote: broadcasters like NBC and Fox have managed to sell 40% to 60% of their ad schedule before the sale season kicks off in May

facts.fact: Super Bowl LXI takes place in Los Angeles in 2027 and will be hosted by Disney's ESPN for the first time in 20 years.
facts.quote: Super Bowl LXI, taking place in Los Angeles in 2027, will be hosted by [Disney's ESPN for the first time in 20 years]
